initial_observation.title: Lowsail Checkpoint
initial_observation.text: Sava lifts the chain for your council mark; redirect the next surge at Red Sluice.

observation.title: Lowsail Checkpoint
observation.text: Sava honors your charter, opening the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee. The chain stands open; Sava directs you to the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.
observation.result: Sava honors your charter, opening the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.

observation.title: Lowsail Levee
observation.text: You move along the connected path. The levee road runs east to Red Sluice. Workers brace the wet embankment.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Floor
observation.text: The charter opens the guarded Sluice path. Water pounds the lower gate. Edrik holds a broken gauge above the intake.
observation.result: The charter opens the guarded Sluice path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Mira waits beside the control wheels. A hot service ladder climbs into steam.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: The market stays dry while the upland works lose water. This surge is settled; choose Return to Lowsail to see the result.
observation.result: The market stays dry while the upland works lose water.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Oren, Sava, and Mira survey dry Lowsail while the upland works lose their water.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You enforce council control while the upland works absorb the loss. Oren, Sava, and Mira survey dry Lowsail while the upland works lose their water.
observation.result: You enforce council control while the upland works absorb the loss.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop. Nessa offers two clay and one mesh for plugs or screening; optional work uses tide steps. Plugs unlock Lowsail's three-coin sorting job after the tide; screening saves two stamina loading freight.
observation.result: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop.

observation.title: Fume Yards Ash Beds
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Daro offers the trapped filter for clearing his rack; safe bracing costs two stamina. Pulling quickly risks a 25% chance of breakage.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Ash Beds
observation.text: You pay Daro four coins and take the caged filter. His rack stock stays separate. Daro's collateral trade is settled; the cage has no second filter.
observation.result: You pay Daro four coins and take the caged filter. His rack stock stays separate.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Nessa offers two clay and one mesh for plugs or screening; optional work uses tide steps. Plugs unlock Lowsail's three-coin sorting job after the tide; screening saves two stamina loading freight.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product. Two clay and one mesh: plugs unlock three-coin sorting after Lowsail's tide; screening saves two stamina locally.
observation.result: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You press two clay and one mesh into repair plugs. Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide. Nessa's stock is spent; Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.
observation.result: You press two clay and one mesh into repair plugs. Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You load the freight and clear loose ash, spending two stamina. Nessa pays two coins; this job is finished. Nessa's stock is spent; Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.
observation.result: You load the freight and clear loose ash, spending two stamina. Nessa pays two coins; this job is finished.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Oren, Sava, and Mira survey dry Lowsail while the upland works lose their water.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You use the repair plugs on Oren's raised sorting stand. Sort Dry Goods now pays three coins once. Oren's patched stand awaits dry goods in dry Lowsail; the upland works still lack water.
observation.result: You use the repair plugs on Oren's raised sorting stand. Sort Dry Goods now pays three coins once.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: Oren orders a filter and one stored cask. Ask Pera at Kiln Bay to carry it. The stand needs a filter and cask; the upland works still lack water.
observation.result: Oren orders a filter and one stored cask. Ask Pera at Kiln Bay to carry it.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You fit one filter to the repaired stand. Add the stored cask before drawing clean water. The fitted filter needs a cask; the upland works still lack water.
observation.result: You fit one filter to the repaired stand. Add the stored cask before drawing clean water.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop. Nessa's clay, mesh, and freight job are spent; your workshop work remains finished.
observation.result: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Pera can hand over her cask for Lowsail; collect it, then escort her.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: Pera hands over her sole cask for Lowsail. Escort her with it so Oren receives her report. Your unused cask can supply Lowsail; escort Pera so she can identify it to Oren.
observation.result: Pera hands over her sole cask for Lowsail. Escort her with it so Oren receives her report.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Bring Pera from Kiln Bay to identify your cask; the upland works still lack water.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.
